must_identify.item: The new api pods exit because the name redis does not resolve
The cause is the pod's dnsPolicy None / dnsConfig search domains (cluster.internal), not REDIS_HOST, the redis Service or CoreDNS

notes: The RCA only reports surface symptoms: the readiness probe gets connection refused and the Service has no ready endpoints. It never mentions DNS, redis resolution or the dnsConfig change. Its suggested fixes (port checks, probe delay, generic log review) do not match any acceptable fix.
